levels.name: Platform / station building level
levels.note: Station building (1921, Thure Hellström) on the city side at Hämeentie 16; platform 1 (track 1) runs along it; island platform tracks 2/3 beyond. VR: the station building is accessible from the platforms. No signposted level names found.

levels.name: Underpass (alikulkutunneli, 1999)
levels.note: Wikipedia: new underpass tunnel completed 1999 with the renewal of the passenger yard. OSM puts it on level -1 with stairs and lifts to platform 1 and island 2/3.

levels.name: Viipurintie bridge (Viipurintien ylikulkusilta)
levels.note: Road bridge with footways over the tracks at the north end; OSM stairs w121199264 (level 0;1) lead down to island platform 2/3. Heights: no source measures them.

answers.question: (no open-question list for Finland yet; brief priority 1: levels, which platforms have stairs/lifts, entrances, hours)
answers.answer: Three platforms: track 1 (side platform by the building) and island 2/3 (Digitraffic, Wikipedia). Underpass (1999) with lift + stairs to platform 1 and to island 2/3 (VR confirms lifts to the platforms; positions from OSM). Stairs also from the Viipurintie bridge down to island 2/3 (OSM only). Waiting room 05:15-00:10 daily. In the building: R-kioski, Asemaravintola, toilets, TalletusOtto, ticket machine.
answers._source: https://vr.fi/en/railway-stations-and-routes/hameenlinna, read 2026-10-30; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/H%C3%A4meenlinna_railway_station, read 2026-10-30; OpenStreetMap (osmfacts extract /home/claude/osmfacts_fi/FI-HL.json), read 2026-10-30; Digitraffic infra-api laiturit via /home/claude/packs_fi/FI-HL/_report.json (Väylävirasto/Fintraffic, CC BY 4.0), read 2026-10-30
